founderAnswers.topic: How the T008 units are launched
founderAnswers.terms: Unchanged: a root launcher with a T008 mode starts the driver as braidlab in its own Background session (launchctl asuser). The orchestrator runs its check automatically (passwordless sudo rule for check only); the owner runs `sudo ... run` in Terminal.app with the password and types the quota readings.

The two disagreed, so the founder was asked again here.
founderAnswers.question: There are two different T008 answers from you. You told me "+1 unit, cap 5 (Recommended)" (recorded in #1426; PR #1428 sets the cap to 5). The HAR plan session says you answered "2 unidades (Recomendado)" there: one unit for the verdict and one spare for a host failure, the second not used if the first completes, outside the 16 T014 units. Which one holds? Cap 6 means changing PR #1428 (6 instead of 5) and a new founder record that supersedes T008-9. Undo: lower the cap again with a record.
founderAnswers.terms: The T008-6 terms otherwise unchanged; cap 6 serial units for the whole cohort (two units left; the second only if the first does not complete because of a host failure). Not counted toward the 16 T014 units. Implemented by scripts/har_t008_unit.py MAX_UNITS = 6 in the pull request that adds this answer. executionAuthorization stays false.
